 SBI CLERK MAINS EXAM 2026 SCHEDULED FOR NOVEMBER 26 
 SBI Clerk Mains Exam 2026 scheduled for November 26, Check Details
 SBI Clerk Mains Exam 2026 for regular vacancies will be conducted on November 26, 2026. The recruitment drive is being conducted for 9,766 Junior Associate vacancies, including 7,680 regular and 2,086 backlog posts. Khushi Priya 12 Nov, 2026 Share

 What Candidates Should Do Next 
 The State Bank of India has announced the SBI Clerk Mains Exam Date 2026 for candidates who qualify in the Preliminary Examination. The Mains examination for the regular recruitment is scheduled to be held on November 26, 2026.
 The recruitment is for the post of Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) under Regular Recruitment with 9,766 vacancies. The selection process comprises the Preliminary Examination, Mains Examination and Language Proficiency Test (LPT).   
 Candidates who have cleared the SBI Clerk Prelims will be eligible to appear for the Mains examination. The Mains call letter will be made available through the SBI Careers page.   
 Candidates can also check UPSC ESE Exam Date 2027 and the complete Prelims schedule, shift timings and exam details. Check UPSC ESE Exam Date 2027 .

 The recruitment includes 7,680 regular vacancies and 2,086 backlog vacancies. The Preliminary Examination was conducted on September 26 and 27, 2026.   
 SBI Clerk Selection Process 2026
 The selection process for SBI Clerk 2026 consists of three stages:
 Preliminary Examination
 Mains Examination
 Language Proficiency Test (LPT)
 Candidates who qualify the Preliminary Examination can appear for the Mains examination. After clearing the Mains stage, candidates have to appear for the LPT wherever applicable.   
 Candidates can also check  AFCAT 1 Apply Online 2027 details, including the application dates, eligibility, vacancies and direct application link.
 SBI Clerk Mains Exam Pattern 2026
 The SBI Clerk Mains examination will consist of 190 questions carrying 200 marks. The total duration of the examination is 2 hours 40 minutes, with separate time limits for each section.

 With the SBI Clerk Mains Exam scheduled for November 26, 2026, candidates who have qualified for the next stage should focus on Mains preparation and keep checking the SBI Careers page for the release of the Mains call letter. Candidates should also verify the reporting time, examination centre and other instructions mentioned on their call letter.
